instruction: Please act as a professional verilog designer. Design a module that implements a 4-bit magnitude comparator. The module should have two inputs: a 4-bit A input and a 4-bit B input. The module should have three outputs: EQ (equal), GT (greater than), and LT (less than). The EQ output should be high if A equals B. The GT output should be high if A is greater than B. The LT output should be high if A is less than B. Hint: Use a case statement to implement the comparison logic.
